Value: Mop Up the Remnants of Demon King’s Army
Spy in the Faithful of the Goddess
Joan is looking for delicious wine to drink. If it tastes a bit bloody, that’s even better.
Aria is looking for someone to buy a lot of marshmallows, which are on sale at the town market.
Procure medical herbs that can treat the wounded animals and bring them to Allain.
Someone wants to buy them cotton candy in secret. Who would they be?
Catalina is suffering from insomnia, so she is looking for someone to sing a lullaby for her. No tone-deaf singers!
Lane is asking to find a cartridge case which she lost during firing practice. What’s so important about it?
Crissy is looking for quality iron ores. She said she’s making another hammer.
Rima is looking for a housekeeper to do the dishes instead of her. She said it’s ok if you’re bad at cooking.
Candy is looking for a volunteer for the clinical trial of a new potion.
Reah is looking for someone to give out flyers at a nearby village. You can't read what’s on the flyer.
Hop around the bars in town and spread rumors about Camila’s assassination skill. With a little bit of an exaggeration...
Townsfolk are looking for someone to eradicate the boars that are ruining the crops.
Harvest fruit at an orchard where is shorthanded. The fruit will rot if harvested too late.
The nuns in town are looking for someone to look after orphans who lost their parents by the Demon King’s army.
Help Noa and mop up the remnants of the Demon King’s army. She said time is short.
Follow Mathilda and collect debts from debtors who have borrowed money from the town and are deliberately not paying back.
Natalia wants someone to procure food and load it on her pirate ship. She prefers food that will keep, like canned food.
Emma is looking for someone to assist her in a magic show planned to be performed in the town.
Barbara is looking for a helping hand in hunting bisons. She said she had to make jerky too.
Gather information about the Demon King and inform Kate.
Meryl wants someone to go to the ruined palace of Romanetia and find her favorite book.
Ruin is asking for a special rope. She said it’s for wrapping a gift.
Maria is looking for someone to repair the church destroyed by the Demon King's army.
Natasha wants the specialty liquor produced in this region. She said she’d whoop your butt if you're late.
Salt is looking for rare ingredients to use in a cooking contest.
Fix the rampart collapsed during the battle with the Demon King’s army.
Treat the people injured by the Demon King’s army.
Patrol near the town in the night so that the townsfolk can shake off their anxiety and finally go to sleep.
Chloe is looking for a sparring partner for her martial arts training.
Hilde is looking for someone to procure the seed of a rare flower which inhabits only in this region.
Patima is looking for someone who will do her tiresome works for her. The pay is quite handsome.
Tia wants to sell her handwoven sweater at an exorbitant price. Would it be possible?
Margaret is asking to investigate the whereabouts of her missing son. Good luck.
Teresa is looking for bombs she’ll use in battles. She said the bigger the bomb, the better.
Investigate a fishy cave with Suyoung in search of the secret method to become a human. It might be a bit scary…
Help the church in a bad-off town with Angela. Of course, you have to make a contribution too.
Miko is looking for someone to procure shamanic ink which she’ll use to write special talismans.
For some reason, you have to continuously shine a bright light on Behemo. What’s this all about?
A request to remove a huge mutant Slime. It’s actually not as dangerous as it sounds.
A request to purify the soil contaminated by Mushroom Kid spores. It must be done to let the plants grow back.
A request to restore the forest destroyed by the Demon King’s army so that animals can inhabit that place again.
A request to extinguish a huge forest fire caused by the monsters of the Demon King’s army.
Bianca wants to retrieve her parcel which got lost during delivery. She said there was a designer bag in the parcel.
Quickly, deliver the luxurious dessert made by Sugar. It will go stale if delivered too late.
With Sophia, research the method to float a big object using magic. If you’re not the smart type, don't even try.
Ivana is looking for someone to provide fresh blood for her. She said she’d use a syringe.
Ladriel is looking for an assistant to help in her Elvish etiquette lessons. The lessons will go for two consecutive days…
Kate is looking for a teammate to ambush the resting monsters with her.
Help Charlotte and rescue the children held by monsters. Hurry up!
Find Sana who has gone missing. The requestor is...Sana?
Patima is looking for someone to divide mana oil into small containers and deliver them while she is sleeping.
Wear a swimsuit and have a great time at the beach with Behemo. Why is this even on the board?
Find out a Polymorph which infiltrated into the town. The townsfolk will be in danger if it’s too late!
Sneak into the area where the Demon King’s army is staying and assassinate the officer. This is a very dangerous job.
A large Mushroom Kid habitat is discovered, causing damage to a lot of people.
The polluted well in town is making people sick. Purify it quickly!
Carry out a secret mission with Teresa. You have to pay 10 times the penalty than normal for breach of contract if you divulge the details.
The Dark Moon council is looking for someone to guard the coven. What gathering would it be about?
Help Emma and recover the stolen Vegas safe key. Would the key be something precious?
A spy has infiltrated into the Faithful of the Goddess. Help Angela in finding the spy.
Bianca is looking for Albatross feathers that will be used for her new hat.
Patima requests to restore a dry oasis in the desert for her. Would it be possible?
Remove the assassins from the Turon Empire who are aiming to kill Catalina. What kind of grudge are they bearing…?
With Lane, eradicate the rebel forces trying to take advantage of the chaos caused by the Demon King and take over Helvetia.
With Ivana, defeat the Demon King’s army that infiltrated into the ancient temple of vampire.
Demon King’s army has infiltrated into the blacksmith guild “Gigantic Anvil.” Help Crissy in defeating them!
Follow Natalia in search of the legendary treasure marked on her treasure map. Let it be real this time…
Liberate the port taken over by a gigantic Kraken. You’ll be able to eat fish BBQ after that.
Guard the merchant group who are transporting expensive goods. The pay for you will be quite handsome!
Remove the huge Mushroom Kid appeared at Great Wall. People are unable to get near it because of its nasty stench.
Help Teresa and defeat the Demon King’s army that infiltrated into a temple of the Goddess. How did the Demon King’s army get into a place like that?
With Maria, drive out the heathens who are secretly worshipping the Demon King in town.
Ruin is looking for someone to fight the monsters of the void with her. She said they were terrible things.
Behemo is asking to close an unstable dimensional gate which is about to explode. Wonder what’s on the other side of that door?
The townsfolk are getting exhausted due to a sudden rise in temperature. Lower the temperature with Natasha!
Margaret is looking for an applicant who will enter the sword-fight contest, which is held by the Goddess, with her.
Angela is looking for someone to help her in the annual Goddess’s Day Festival. What a grand festival!
Bianca is looking for the wings of the archangel. She said you can name your price!
Take Urobo, who got lost in the territory of the Demon King’s army, and escape. They are coming!
Save Candy from the lab which is about to explode due to a strange alchemy experiment!
Investigate the mysterious mirrors which have been handed down from ancient times and gather information about them.
The Demon King’s army is making suspicious movements lately. Check them and find out what they are planning.
A request to save the townsfolk who are in danger of being executed by the Demon King’s army. Hurry up!
The whole city is on fire! Extinguish flames and save people!

1.After defeating the enemies on the current floor, you will be rewarded and allowed to challenge the next floor.<%enter%><%enter%>2.If you can't beat them, try adjusting the formation of your Heroes or look up the formations of other users who have cleared the floor.

Legends say the tower was built by Cromynong, the one and only Demon King in Mythcardo. No one could tell whether it was really built by the Demon King or if he really resides in it, but the Heroes continued to head for the top of the tower. Now, they are just ascending the skyscraper, their initial goal long forgotten. Since there has not been any word about anyone reaching the top floor yet, the tower is always filled with new challengers taking on the monsters there.

1.Each entry displays User Ranking of your current server and has a reward quest.<%enter%><%enter%>2.Information of the first user to complete the quest on the current server is displayed in the Rewards Menu.<%enter%><%enter%>3.If a user completes the quest, all users on this server can obtain rewards.<%enter%><%enter%>4.In the Elemental Points Ranking, Elemental Points are determined based on the Grade of the princess you have.. The higher the princess’s Grade, the more points you’ll get. If you have multiple copies of the same princess, then only the one with the highest Grade will be applied.<%enter%><%enter%>5.C Grade: 0p, B Grade: 5p, B+ Grade: 15p, A Grade: 50p, A+ Grade: 150p, S Grade: 500p, S+ Grade: 650p, SS Grade: 1,300p, SS+ Grade: 2,000p, SSS Grade: 2,500p, and +300 per additional Star

The Heroes of Mythcardo are always up to brag about their astonishing records and achievements. The records of those who have ranked themselves high through fierce competition will remain here forever.

1.You can improve the Grade of your Hero at the Temple of Goddess.<%enter%><%enter%>2.Promotion may require to consume a Hero.<%enter%><%enter%>3.After the Promotion, the consumed Hero will disappear, but you will receive their Equipments and Golds, EXP, and Jewels of Goddess used to train them back into your bag.<%enter%><%enter%>4. Additional star ratings can be raised after SSS rating.<%enter%><%enter%>5. Star ratings can be promoted up to 15 stars.

Temple of Goddess is the place of worship for the Goddess who watches over Mythcardo and where her priests bless the Heroes. Due to countless Heroes solving many problems instead of her, the Goddess gradually lost her reason for doing work herself. Eventually, she forgot how to invoke her power and even lost the power itself, but the temple still remains since her priests are doing her job instead.

1.You can add up to 30 friends.<%enter%><%enter%>2.Every day you can send Friendship Points up to 30 friends and receive Friendship Points from up to 20 friends.<%enter%><%enter%>3.You can use Friendship Points to summon Heroes at the Tavern.
The only way to have a friend is to be one.

1.For each hero, you can lend them to only one friend, and the friend can use them as Mercenary for up to a week. Mercenaries will return to their original owner on Sunday at 24:00.(Monday UTC 00:00)<%enter%><%enter%>2.Only Heroes of S Grade or above can be used as Mercenaries.<%enter%><%enter%>3.Only one Mercenary can be used for one victory each at Tower of Cromynong and Adventure Stage.<%enter%><%enter%>4.Its availability is deducted only in case of winning the battle.<%enter%><%enter%>5.You can hire up to 3 Mercenaries and request their service up to 5 times.<%enter%><%enter%>6.Grade of a Mercenary is determined based on the actual Grade of the Mercenary, and their level and Equipment is determined based on the average Combat Power of top 5 Heroes of the user who leased them.<%enter%><%enter%>7.Hero of a friend who didn’t login for more than 7 days cannot be used as Mercenary.

Teammates will be a great help on the journey to save Mythcardo from the current crisis. They will be staunch allies to aid you in getting over critical situations. It is by no means a shame to get your teammate's help when you have faced something you can't overcome by yourself.

1.You can obtain Colosseum Points and rewards by fighting other users in the Colosseum.<%enter%><%enter%>2.You can fight other users for free up to 3 times a day. Colosseum Ticket is required to fight more after that.<%enter%><%enter%>3.Colosseum Points increase by winning and decrease by losing.<%enter%><%enter%>4.A Colosseum Season lasts 2 weeks. At the end of a Season, you obtain rewards according to your Ranking, and Colosseum Points will be reset.<%enter%><%enter%>5.You need to enter the Colosseum once in every new season to participate.

No one knows when it started, but everyone knows there will be no end of fight in the Colosseum. No, nothing but endless competition and challengers aiming for higher ground. And there are only two results: resplendent glory or bottomless despair.

1.You can reset Hero of level 2 or above.<%enter%><%enter%>2.After reset, the Hero will revert back to level 1, receiving the items and Gold spent to train the Hero, and all their Equipment will be unequipped.

They say those who go through the Gate of Rebirth get all their past mistakes cleansed and be born anew. Although a little toll is required, numerous people who wish to make a fresh start are living new lives after going through the Gate of Rebirth.

1.Sky Maze resets every 48 hours. When it resets, every path and tile are newly created.<%enter%><%enter%>2.You can move on tiles according to the result of the dice you rolled.<%enter%><%enter%>3.After moving onto a tile, you proceed with the action according to the tile.<%enter%><%enter%>4.If it is a Battle Tile, you have to defeat all the enemies to roll the dice for your next move.<%enter%><%enter%>5.HP lost in the battle does not get restored automatically. You have to stand on a Healing Tile or use a healing item to restore it. If a Hero dies, you can't reuse them. In order to reuse a dead Hero, you must revive them via Revival Tile.<%enter%><%enter%>6.Sky Maze has 3 stages, and the higher the level, the stronger the enemy and the more lucrative the rewards become.

They say there is a hidden maze in the sky above Mythcardo. Some say that the Goddess has created it in boredom, while others say that it was made to seal the Demon King. The maze, in which you cannot turn back and have to pay a tremendous price to step ahead as much as you want, is told that no one had escaped unharmed unless one’s with extreme luck.

1.Among the Heroes you own, 5 highest-leveled ones become the Standard Heroes and the lowest Level of which becomes the Standard Level.<%enter%><%enter%>2.Heroes placed in slots cannot go past their max Level limit.<%enter%><%enter%>3.When you register a Hero to a slot, their Level synchronizes with the Standard Level; however, you cannot increase the Hero's Level directly. You can only increase it through increasing the Standard Level.<%enter%><%enter%>4.When you remove a Hero from a slot, the slot will take 24 hours of standby before being able to be used again.

Crystal Room is where a Crystal Rock known was made by the Goddess herself is located. It has a mysterious power that allows Heroes who got acknowledged by the Goddess to pass their power on to others. People who long for the power of Heroes constantly visit the Crystal Room, but the opportunity is by no means easy to take.

1.Battle Pass Event renews every 44 days.<%enter%><%enter%>2.You can obtain Battle Pass EXP every time you clear a stage in the Sky Maze.<%enter%><%enter%>3.You can obtain more rewards by obtaining Battle Pass EXP and increasing the rank.<%enter%><%enter%>4.After the renewal of Battle Pass, unobtained rewards will be sent to your Mail Box.<%enter%><%enter%>5.An activated Battle Pass is only effective within its cycle. When the Battle Pass gets renewed, it gets deactivated again.

1.Royal Pass Event renews every 49 days.<%enter%><%enter%>2.You can obtain Royal Pass EXP from the Treasure Boxes you obtain through Daily and Weekly Quests.<%enter%><%enter%>3.You can obtain more rewards by obtaining Royal Pass EXP and increasing the rank.<%enter%><%enter%>4.After the renewal of Royal Pass, unobtained rewards will be sent to your Mail Box.<%enter%><%enter%>5.An activated Royal Pass is only effective within its cycle. When the Royal Pass gets renewed, it gets deactivated again.

1.7-Day Beginner’s Mission gives you 5 missions every day for 7 days.<%enter%><%enter%>2.You obtain rewards and 1 point every time you clear a mission, and you can obtain special rewards according to the accumulated points.<%enter%><%enter%>3.You can progress and clear your missions even after the mission’s initial date, or even if 7 days have passed.

1.You can get a snowflower medal from the reward box when completing daily quests during the event period.<%enter%><%enter%>2.You can obtain the corresponding reward by exchanging it for the number of snowflower medals specified for each reward.<%enter%><%enter%>3.Each reward can be exchanged only a set number of times.<%enter%><%enter%>4.At the end of the event, the remaining snowflower medals will be calculated as 5000 gold and paid.

1.You can get a Spring Seeds from the reward box when completing daily quests during the event period.<%enter%><%enter%>2.You can obtain the corresponding reward by exchanging it for the number of Spring Seeds specified for each reward.<%enter%><%enter%>3.Each reward can be exchanged only a set number of times.<%enter%><%enter%>4.At the end of the event, the remaining Spring Seed will be calculated as 5000 gold and paid.

1.World Colosseum consists of 6 Tiers: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Master.<%enter%><%enter%>2.Each Tier consists of several groups, and based on the result of competition within your group, you can be elevated to an upper Tier, demoted to a lower Tier, or survive in your current Tier.<%enter%><%enter%>3.Elevation / survival / demotion is conducted at every interim settlement, and you will be shuffled into a new group after it is finished.<%enter%><%enter%>4.In the World Colosseum, you can only fight against other players in your current group.<%enter%><%enter%>5.If you have never participated in the World Colosseum before interim settlement, you will be automatically demoted to a lower Tier.

A new competition is arising to decide who is the most powerful. The only thing that exists here is fierce competition, and no one can achieve anything without struggling with all their might. Only one person can ascend to the throne of glory, but no one can ever reign supreme forever.

1.At the Training Camp, you can undergo 5 training courses using Training Seals and Gold.<%enter%><%enter%>2.If you undergo each training course once, the Training Progress increases by 1, and you can take up to 150 training sessions.<%enter%><%enter%>3.Training Seals can be obtained from the World Colosseum.<%enter%><%enter%>4.The result of the training you have taken will be applied to all Heroes.

You should not neglect your training if you wish to attain power to stand above all else. Although it will be challenging and arduous, the result will bring you tremendous honor. May you train hard and become supremely mighty.

1.Guild Members can obtain Guild Points through Daily Quests.<%enter%><%enter%>2.Only the Guild Master and Mercenary Captain can lease Mercenaries to Guild Members.<%enter%><%enter%>3.Guild Boss is available for a certain period of time, and a member of a Guild can challenge them twice for free.<%enter%><%enter%>4.The buff will be strengthened each time the Boss loses a certain amount of their HP.<%enter%><%enter%>5.Guild Members who participated in the raid can obtain additional rewards according to the highest amount of damage they’ve dealt.<%enter%><%enter%>6.Guild Coins can be used at the Guild Shop.<%enter%><%enter%>7. Some Bosses needs to be unlocked first by the Guild Leader or the Vice Guild Leader using Guild Points.

You need thorough practice and training in order to defeat the Demon King. The captured subordinates of the Demon King should make for good practice targets. Even though it is just training, you must remember that you can still run into danger if you don't treat it like a real battle.

1.If you have 2 or more duplicated Elite Class Heroes who are S Grade or above, you can revert the S Grade Hero whose Grade is lower among them.<%enter%><%enter%>2. When reverting a hero, you will be getting the same hero of the lower grade (level succeeded) that you are reverting, a hero or hero card for promotion, or a slime.

1.During the event, you can obtain Cherry Blossom Leaves from the reward boxes after completing a Daily Quest.<%enter%><%enter%>2.Each reward is priced at a certain number of Cherry Blossom Leaves, and you can get them by exchanging the corresponding number of leaves.<%enter%><%enter%>3.Each reward can only be exchanged a specified number of times.<%enter%><%enter%>4.At the end of the event, you will receive 5,000 Gold per remaining Cherry Blossom Leaf.

1.You can accept various kinds of requests from the Request Board and receive appropriate rewards after the princesses complete the request.<%enter%><%enter%>2.There are Solo Request and Team Request. When you’re carrying out a Team Request, you must get help from the princesses of your friend or Guildmate.<%enter%><%enter%>3.Every request requires a different princess with a specific Grade and Element, and a princess cannot carry out several requests at the same time.<%enter%><%enter%>4.If you refresh the Request Board, it will reset all the Solo Request, including those you didn’t carry out. The list refreshes once a day at the appointed hour, and you can spend Stars to refresh again after that.<%enter%><%enter%>5.Once a day at the appointed hour, one Team Request gets added to the Request Board. Once added, the request stays on the board for 7 days.

Everyone who needs help can use the Request Board.<%enter%>As long as you have something you can pay with!<%enter%>The townsfolk of the towns where you or your teammates have stayed will use this Request Board.<%enter%>Help them and receive the rewards offered by them.<%enter%>If the requestor is your teammate, you might also get to know their personal secrets as the reward.

1.The arena missions have 5 missions for each item: <%enter%><%enter%>2.Whenever each mission is cleared, 1 point is given along with the reward, and special rewards are given according to the accumulated score.

1. You can clean the Guild HQ to get rewards.<%enter%><%enter%>2. Trashes respawn at 00:00 AM, 08:00 AM, and 16:00 PM everyday.(UTC)<%enter%><%enter%>3. There are various rewards such as Gold, Hero EXP, Princess' Tiara, Star, Queen's Tribute, etc.

1. You can receive rewards after exploring Underground Dungeon.<%enter%><%enter%>2. You can restart Underground Dungeon anytime, but the major rewards can be obtained only once and cannot be obtained again.<%enter%><%enter%>3. Your face tells me that you won’t leave right away. Let’s go, my cute little sister. Come on.
I didn’t expect to meet you in a place like this. Maybe it was meant to be.
Are you going to do something to me?
No, that’s not what I have planned. For some reason, I think you and I are here for the same purpose…
How about we accompany each other for a little while?
The legion… No, the queen visited here. That means…
That means she’s looking for something, just like you. Isn’t that right?
I don't know if it’s here or not, but I’m not planning to give it away.
Looks like the thing we’re looking for isn't here.
But at least we found some useful stuff. Not bad at all.
Don't worry. Am I that untrustworthy to you?
But you’d better not trust me too much.
Looks like our investigation is over once again. Now…
Heheh. You don’t have to be nervous.
I had a bit of fun today, so I’ll let it slide, just this once.
Yes. I’ll take a rain check on the real fun…
Welcome to the great valley of Barbaria.
I didn't even want to come here…
Do you feel the souls of the great heroes of Barbaria?
No, I don't really feel anything like…
This place has been the site for great heroes to test their courage for centuries.
But only a few people made it back.
However, their souls still live in this place!
Hey, you can’t call that living…
Now! Let us test our courage!
The loot is much better than I expected…
Thank the souls of the great heroes.
You can be like them, too!
Hey, are you telling me to die or…
The great heroes are with us!
The souls of the great heroes have acknowledged our courage.
Well, that wasn't as hard as I…
Now, a fiercer trial awaits us.
Wait, I really don't want to…
Ah… Sh-she said she suddenly had this emergency…
An emergency? Of course she would.
By the way, what’s she doing today? I’ll just take a look…
“Oh! Thank you again for your donation, GP2016!”
Well, at least she’s working hard.
You don't have to answer everything she says…
It’s not like she can see us.
“As always, I had a lotta fun with you today!”
Well… Maybe I could consider this as a proper reunion.
“Of course! Alright, see you next time, everyone!”
A stick that looks like a piece remained after making a broom. Can it really wield magic?
A sword made of roughly carved wood. Isn’t this a toy for children?
A thick wooden stick. People want money for this?
A cheap headband you can easily get in a general store. It's quite doubtful if anyone would really want this.
A hood made of leather. Looks like it would be mainly worn by blacksmiths.
A leather helmet attached with a horn. The big horn makes it quite heavy.
A cloak mainly worn when it's rainy or snowy. People use it to prevent the clothes they hold dear from getting wet.
A corset used to tighten the wearer's waist. It's for making you look thin, not for battle.
An armor made by putting thick leather over the clothes. It's heavy and ugly.
Shoes made of collected worn and faded cloths. The merit is that they are very cheap.
Light shoes made of thin leather. The light weight makes them easy to be used throughout daily life.
Shoes made by roughly sewing thick leather. Water leaks when it's rainy.
A mage's staff which is supposedly made of 100-year-old wood. No one knows whether it was made of wood grown for 100 years or 100 years had passed after it was cut down.
A spear made by adding an iron edge at the tip of a wooden stick. It's mainly used to hunt small animals due to its short length.
A mace that has a big ball of iron. It's pretty good for smashing a monster's skull in.
A hood usually worn by Druids living in the woods. It was dyed green so that the wearer wouldn't get noticed by dangerous beasts in the woods.
A hood made of black-dyed leather. People mainly use it when they didn't wear makeup or didn't wash their hair.
A helmet made of quite solid iron. The design makes it look like it was crafted more than 500 years ago.
A robe made by Druids living in the woods. It's relatively cheap and rather durable, but green drops of water trickle from it during heavy rain.
A guard made to protect the wearer's chest when using a bow. It's fairly practical.
An armor attached with a big iron plate. Looks like it was made to be unisex.
Shoes made by Druids living in the woods. Crafted with quite durable thick clothes, they can be used for a long time even on rough terrains in the woods.
Shoes made of soft sheepskin. The soft feel makes them a favorite among many women.
Shoes made by putting iron over leather. Cheap and sturdy, but no ventilation at all.
A staff made of low-grade blue crystal. Many people use it for its high cost-performance, but buyer discretion is advised because some staves are made with fake crystals.
An ordinary sword made of steel. It's light and easy to use.
A single-bladed axe made of steel. Looks like it can cut a thick tree down in one swing.
A hat for students made by Aqua Mage Academy. Poor mages tend to use this school uniform hat even after graduation.
A tiara made of steel. It doesn't provide much defense, but it helps the wearer by keeping their forelock from blocking the sight.
A helmet made of steel. It looks crude but very sturdy.
A robe for students made by Aqua Mage Academy. This school uniform robe is dyed in blue, the color of water which is the symbol of Aqua.
A leather armor intended to be worn by ladies for hunting. It's crafted using fine leather, making it feel soft and allowing the wearer to look thin.
An armor made of steel. It's a decent product released relatively recently.
Shoes for students made by Aqua Mage Academy. As they're for the children in the academy, they were crafted using tough cloth for lightness and not to get torn easily.
Shoes intended to be worn by ladies for hunting. The shin part has an iron plate to protect the wearer from the fangs of snakes while hunting in the woods.
Shoes made of steel. They are much sturdier than iron boots but weigh the same.
A crystal staff enhanced using gold imbued with magic. It's said to help the user to focus their magical powers.
A steel sword of which the blade has been keenly sharpened. The added handguard makes it easier to wield.
A steel axe modified to be double-bladed. Now you can chop at monster's skulls with both sides.
The academy hat attached with a ribbon that is said to give slight boost in Mana recovery. It was popular among female students who were into fashion, but the ribbon’s power is just a rumor.
A steel tiara designed to be lighter and prettier. Its popularity is based on the slot poked in the middle which lets the wearer put a jewel of their choice in it.
A lightened steel helmet decorated with a gold stripe. It got lighter and sturdier, and the gold stripe is enchanted with a magical effect that blocks ultraviolet rays.
A robe made by Aqua Mage Academy for student council members. It looks classier than the robes for ordinary students.

A hunting leather armor enhanced by adding chainmail on the chest part. It was ostensibly modified to provide better defense, but it is widely accepted that this was just added to emphasize the wearer's chest.
A lightened steel armor decorated with a gold stripe. It got lighter and sturdier, and there is a magical wire inside the gold stripe that conforms to the wearer's shape.
The academy shoes attached with a ribbon that is said to give slight boost in Mana recovery. Its more for fashion that practicality, just like the hat.
Hunting leather shoes enhanced by adding leather on their top. Rather than provide better defense, they are modified to prevent foot odor by blocking rain from leaking into the shoes.
Lightened steel boots decorated with gold stripes. They got lighter and sturdier, and the gold stripes are enchanted with a magic that prevents the wearer from getting calluses on their heels.

A staff made by "Dark Moon," the council of witches. Its original intent was to be distributed to the witches of the witch council, but now it's being sold in various places thanks to its great performance.
A weapon of the "Nightowl" equipment series made by a famous fashion brand based in Francisco. It's a lightweight long spear with two very sharp edges.
A weapon of the "Holy War" equipment series made by the "Gigantic Anvil," a union of blacksmiths, for the allied forces. It is suitable for attacking heavily-armored monsters in close combat.
A hat made by the "Dark Moon," the council of witches. Caution: Since the hat was made for witches, places like the church will not welcome you if you're wearing it.

A weapon of the "Nightowl" equipment series made by a famous fashion brand based in Francisco. With its befitting design of a Francisco-born brand, the tiara became a huge vogue among daughters of nobles across various countries.

A helmet of the "Holy War" equipment series made by the "Gigantic Anvil," a union of blacksmiths, for the allied forces. Many knights favor it because it allows the wearer to lift the faceguard and reveal their faces when they’re not fighting.

A robe made by the "Dark Moon," the council of witches. Since witches are famous for being skilled in weaving clothes imbued with the essence of the moon, this peculiar purple robe enhances the wearer's magical powers.

A light armor of the "Nightowl" equipment series made by a famous fashion brand based in Francisco. Among its design features, the nightowl embodied on the chest part stands out. As it is made with chain, it is durable and rather light.

A heavy armor of the "Holy War" equipment series made by the "Gigantic Anvil," a union of blacksmiths, for the allied forces. Being the formal armor for the allied forces' knights, it is said to be fine in both the quality and the design.

Shoes made by the "Dark Moon," the council of witches. Most cloth shoes are lightweight, but the shoes made by witches are especially famous for their lightness. People say that it almost feel like you're walking barefoot.

Hunting shoes of the "Nightowl" equipment series made by a famous fashion brand based in Francisco. Using only the finest sheepskin, they are very soft and durable, favored by nobles' daughters for battle or hunting.

Steel boots of the "Holy War" equipment series made by the "Gigantic Anvil," a union of blacksmiths, for the allied forces. Many have commented favorably on them since it was made by putting several plates together, allowing the wearer to move their ankles smoothly.

A lightened version of Dark Moon staff following the opinion that the former staff is too heavy. Changing the heavy crystal ball into a lightweight and fine amethyst, the staff is now lighter and able to wield more magical power.
A modified version of "Nightowl" series by a famous arms artisan of Francisco. The trident's edges have gotten bigger, lighter, and sharper, allowing the user to attack faster and with more power.

A modified and enhanced version of the "Holy War" equipment series intended to be used by the defending forces of the "Great Wall." The mace has gotten bigger and heavier, allowing the user to destroy enemies' armor more efficiently.

A witch hat added with a cooling feature. A patch of cool cloth enchanted with cooling magic is attached inside of the hat to cool off the wearer's head when it gets heated up due to heavy magic usage.
A modified version of "Nightowl" series by a famous arms artisan of Francisco. The added golden ornament allows the wearer to understand the enemies' movements more easily in battle.

A modified and enhanced version of the "Holy War" equipment series intended to be used by the defending forces of the "Great Wall." The only modification is the addition of an iron plate on the top part to buffer the impact.
The magical embroidery, added to improve the former boring design of Dark Moon robe, has gotten good reactions for both the design and the performance.

A modified version of "Nightowl" series by a famous arms artisan of Francisco. With the addition of a magical golden ornament on the chest part and the enhancement on the shoulder part, it can now provide an extra layer of defense.

A modified and enhanced version of the "Holy War" equipment series intended to be used by the defending forces of the "Great Wall." A vent is added to the armor to fight the Great Wall's hot weather, and a quality lining is added inside to provide much better defense.

As Dark Moon Shoes were light but not quite durable, the insides are now added with linings, and the ankle part with two types of cloths to boost its durability. They also got positive reactions because the modification made the wearer's ankles to look thin.

A modified version of the "Nightowl" series by a famous arms artisan of Francisco. They are added with golden and silver ornaments on the shin part which are enchanted with magic to quickly recover the legs from fatigue.

A modified and enhanced version of the "Holy War" equipment series intended to be used by the defending forces of the "Great Wall." Vents are added to the boots just like the armor, and the ankle part is ornamented with a magical gold lining to allow the feet to get air under hot weather.

A staff of the "Starlight" equipment series made by the High Elves of Saviour. It is said that only a few truly skilled people could obtain this staff.

A weapon of the "Eagle" series, a premium line produced by the brand in Francisco that made the Nightowl series. It's a dual-edged long spear of which the edges are made of a special alloy, making them very light and sharp.

A weapon of the "Valkyrie" equipment series made by the "Gigantic Anvil" for Romanetia. A one-bladed axe made of black steel alloy which only the "Gigantic Anvil" can produce, and its blade enhanced with magic-imbued gold, it can crush the enemy's thick armor at one stroke.

A hat of the "Starlight" equipment series made by the High Elves of Saviour. High Elves don't really like witches, but they used High Elven cloths and Dark Moon made cloths together to produce as many hats as they could.

A tiara of the "Eagle" series, a premium line produced by the brand in Francisco that made the Nightowl series. It won first place in Francisco's annual Design of the Year Award. The performance is excellent too.

A helmet of the "Valkyrie" equipment series made by the "Gigantic Anvil" for Romanetia. It was designed to look valorous and graceful, befitting the product name. It ensures heavy defense for the wearer with the magical platinum gilded upon black steel alloy.

A robe of the "Starlight" equipment series made by the High Elves of Saviour. High Elves are famous for having the strongest magical power among every race. This robe made by them is enchanted with a spell that boosts the wearer's magical power.

A light armor of the "Eagle" series, a premium line produced by the brand in Francisco that made the Nightowl series. It used more quality materials and colors compared to the Nightowl Series, getting positive reactions for both its design and performance.

A heavy armor of the "Valkyrie" equipment series made by the "Gigantic Anvil" for Romanetia. It may look like it's just a slightly improved version of the Holy War series, but some steel plates were replaced with wyvern leather to make it more durable and allow the wearer to move more easily.

Shoes of the "Starlight" equipment series made by the High Elves of Saviour. Unlike other shoes, its tips are pointing upwards like a horn resembling the High Elven-style shoes, becoming quite a vogue among nobles and princesses.

Leather boots of the "Eagle" equipment series, a premium line produced by the brand in Francisco that made the Nightowl series. These shocking boots, which was a sensational vogue among princesses and nobles' daughters, were the first to introduce the high heel to battle equipment design.

Boots of the "Valkyrie" equipment series made by the "Gigantic Anvil" for Romanetia. They were once only available to the knights of Romanetia, but after the country's collapse, many Valkyrie series equipment came out to the world.

An enhanced version of the "Starlight" equipment series made to save Ethos from the grasp of Demon King's army. A higher-grade starlight jewel was used to maximize the caster's magical power, allowing the wielder to cast magic of tremendous force.

An enhanced version of the “Eagle” series by a famous artisan of Francisco. The addition of blue crystal imbued with magical power and several ornaments made it fancier and stronger, but it failed to win popularity due to its price.

An enhanced version of the "Valkyrie" equipment series done by the Holy See of Cavithan for its Templars. The blade was reinforced to maximize the axe's force against heavy armor, and the Holy See's symbol enchanted with divine power was attached to maximize its might.

An enhanced version of the "Starlight" equipment series made to save Ethos from the grasp of Demon King's army. This version was hurriedly made for Ethos' high mages as the country got cornered, but they say that it was too late to turn the tide of war.

An enhanced version of the “Eagle” series done by a famous artisan of Francisco. The addition of albatross feather improved its design and performance. The reaction being so good, all later models were added with feather decorations.

An enhanced version of the "Valkyrie" equipment series by the Holy See of Cavithan for its Templars. The Templars originally used the Holy War series, but the Pope directly ordered the enhancement as they showed its limit in defense during the battle against the Demon King's army.

An enhanced version of the "Starlight" equipment series made to save Ethos from the grasp of Demon King's army. After Ethos was destroyed by the Demon King's army, the enhanced "Starlight" equipment series were sold to every nation exposed to the Demon King's threat at outrageous prices.

An enhanced version of the “Eagle” series by a famous artisan of Francisco. Since the original was already excellent, only some minor improvements were made, such as adding an enchanted golden ornament. But people say its performance is vastly better.

An enhanced version of the "Valkyrie" equipment series by the Holy See of Cavithan for its Templars. The pelvis guard added to the waist part provides good defense and makes the wearer's waist look thin, which is why it was favored by many knights.

An enhanced version of the "Starlight" equipment series made to save Ethos from the grasp of Demon King's army. It is said that mages hail from Ethos bequeathed these equipment to their descendants to not forget about their destroyed nation.

An enhanced version of the “Eagle” series by a famous artisan of Francisco. As the original model had won too much popularity, it is said that there were endless lines of people in front of shops on its release day.

An enhanced version of the "Valkyrie" equipment series by the Holy See of Cavithan for its Templars. A steel plate imbued with divine power is added to the ankle part which was originally made of leather, providing more defense against small, ankle-biting monsters.

A staff of the "Prophet" equipment series made by the High Elves of Saviour in preparation for the war against the Demon King. It is made of several rare materials unique to High Elves, including a precious fine starlight jewel. It boosts the wielder's magic to its extreme.

A weapon of the "Phoenix" equipment series, a limited line produced by the Francisco brand and only sold to princesses. It's a feather-light and razor-sharp longsword made of the finest steel and blue crystal. Hard to acquire since it's a limited edition.

A weapon of the "Monarch" equipment series, a line that the "Gigantic Anvil" produced only for head knights of various kingdoms on custom orders. The huge dual-bladed axe is made of black steel alloy, and are enhanced with enchanted gold to increase its power.

A hat of the "Prophet" equipment series made by the High Elves of Saviour in preparation for the war against the Demon King. High Elves usually don't go for other races' attires, but fashionable female Elves preferred witch-style hats.

A tiara of the "Phoenix" equipment series , a limited line of equipment produced by the Francisco brand and only sold to princesses. Following the huge popularity of the enhanced "Eagle" series with albatross feather, 6 more feathers were added for decoration. It has overwhelming design AND overwhelming performance altogether!

A helmet of "Monarch" equipment series, a line that the "Gigantic Anvil" produced only for head knights of various kingdoms on custom orders. Since it's for head knights, it used white and red to look graceful and valorous at the same time.

A robe of the "Prophet" equipment series made by the High Elves of Saviour in preparation for the war against the Demon King. Since High Elven cloth is used for most parts of the robe, it is light, very durable, and boosts the wearer's magical power tremendously.

A light armor of the "Phoenix" equipment series, a limited line produced by the Francisco brand and only sold to princesses. As it's a limited edition for princesses, every material used for the armor is of the finest quality, granting it overwhelming performance.

A heavy armor of the "Monarch" equipment series, a line that the "Gigantic Anvil" produced only for head knights of various kingdoms on custom orders. Only head knights were allowed to wear this armor but many princesses used it because of its elegant design.

Shoes of the "Prophet" equipment series made by the High Elves of Saviour in preparation for the war against the Demon King. Being the original model of the Starlight series shoes, even princesses who were not mages lined up before the shop in Saviour to buy them.

High-heeled leather boots of the "Phoenix" equipment series, a limited line produced by the Francisco brand and only sold to princesses. Since it is the most popular item among the Phoenix series, it is sometimes used as a symbol of wealth among princesses.

Boots of the "Monarch" equipment series, a line that the "Gigantic Anvil" produced only for head knights of various kingdoms on custom orders. These heavy armor boots are enchanted with magic to relieve fatigue which can be easily caused by their weight.

An enhanced version of the "Prophet" equipment series modified by Ancacella, the Great Witch of the Dark Moon council. With platinum ornamentation and changing its magical core into the finest starlight jewel, it can emit a tremendous amount of magical power at once. But it is a bit unstable.

An enhanced version of the "Phoenix" equipment series personally done by Francisco's best artisan for selected princesses only. Since it used the finest albatross feather and blue crystal, ordinary princesses can't even dream of buying it.

An enhanced version of the "Monarch" equipment series made by a legendary blacksmith of Dragonia for his lovers. It is said that he used bloodstones made out of his Draconian blood to boost the axe's might.

An enhanced version of the "Prophet" equipment series modified by Ancacella, the Great Witch of the Dark Moon council. High Elves didn't like it at first since Ancacella had modified their equipment without permission. But after seeing its overwhelming performance, their protest were silenced.

An enhanced version of the "Phoenix" equipment series personally done by Francisco's best artisan for selected princesses only. Decorated with golden wings that are enchanted by an Archmage and symbolizes the phoenix, it provides a more elegant design and much stronger performance.

An enhanced version of the "Monarch" equipment series made by a legendary blacksmith of Dragonia for his lovers. It is said that he used his red hair into the helmet's crest to give a dragon’s blessing to its wearer.

An enhanced version of the "Prophet" equipment series modified by Ancacella, the Great Witch of the Dark Moon council. No one knows why she modified the equipment of High Elves, and even the council didn't know about the existence of this equipment.

An enhanced version of the "Phoenix" equipment series personally done by Francisco's best artisan for selected princesses only. This armor, a enhanced "Phoenix" equipment series with enchanted gold and albatross feather, was criticized for being too expensive compared with the materials used. Still, it got sold out right after the release.

An enhanced version of the "Monarch" equipment series made by a legendary blacksmith of Dragonia for his lovers. He is known as a huge womanizer, and people say that he considered giving out these equipment as wearing matching rings between lovers.

An enhanced version of the "Prophet" equipment series modified by Ancacella, the Great Witch of the Dark Moon council. The original Prophet version emjoyed huge popularity too, but the version enhanced by Ancacella was so popular that witches paid premium prices to buy it from others.

An enhanced version of the "Phoenix" equipment series personally done by Francisco's best artisan for selected princesses only. Added with albatross feathers and magical ornaments, both the performance and the design of these boots changed as if this were a completely new model, making it more popular than other parts of the series.

An enhanced version of the "Monarch" equipment series made by a legendary blacksmith of Dragonia for his lovers. Designs for knights' boots have always been conservative through out the history, but he pursued his taste and introduced high heels to heavy armor for the first time.

An enhanced version of the "Prophet" equipment series personally blessed by the Goddess and bestowed on the mage who will seal the Demon King. Since it requires immense power to seal the Demon King, it boosts the wearer's magical power tremendously.

An enhanced version of the "Phoenix" equipment series personally made by the Goddess and bestowed on chosen ones. It is said that the feathers were replaced with an archangel's wings, and 100% pure blue crystal was imbued with the Goddess' own divine power.

An enhanced version of the "Monarch" equipment series the Goddess personally bestows to the winner of the sword-fight contest held in her name. It is said that the axe's whole blade is replaced with special platinum made by the Goddess’s divine power, making it unbreakable under any circumstances.

An enhanced version of the "Prophet" equipment series personally blessed by the Goddess and bestowed on the mage who will seal the Demon King. It is said that the Goddess put several protective spells upon the robe for the mage since the magic to seal the Demon King drains the caster's life force.

An enhanced version of the "Phoenix" equipment series personally made by the Goddess and bestowed on chosen ones. It is said that the hood is attached with a rare jewel and the legendary archangel's wings instead of albatross feathers and holds the Goddess' blessing.

An enhanced version of the "Monarch" equipment series the Goddess personally bestows to the winner of the sword-fight contest held under her name. It is said that the Goddess cut her own hair and enchanted it with special magic to make the bluish crest of the helmet.

An enhanced version of the "Prophet" equipment series personally blessed by the Goddess and bestowed on the mage who will seal the Demon King. It is said that the descendants of the bestowed mage are born with a talent for magic because of the Goddess' blessing.

An enhanced version of the "Phoenix" equipment series personally made by the Goddess and bestowed on chosen ones. Modified using a platinum, the legendary metal, and enchanted by the Goddess along with the archangel's wings, its performance is unparalleled.

An enhanced version of the "Monarch" equipment series the Goddess personally bestows to the winner of the sword-fight contest held under her name. Since the owner of this armor can enjoy a treatment fit for a head knight in every kingdom, numerous gladiators participated in the sword-fight contest.

An enhanced version of the "Prophet" equipment series personally blessed by the Goddess and bestowed on the mage who will seal the Demon King. The wearer of these shoes will leave the fragrant scent of flowers instead of foot odor, no matter how long they wear them.

An enhanced version of the "Phoenix" equipment series personally made by the Goddess and bestowed on chosen ones. The overall design is similar to the "Phoenix" equipment series, but all the materials were replaced with rare ones such as the archangel's wings and platinum, giving it an entirely different level of performance.

An enhanced version of the "Monarch" equipment series the Goddess personally bestows to the winner of the sword-fight contest held under her name. Since the Goddess personally bestowed these high-heeled boots for knights, even conservative knights had to stop criticizing high heels.
One of the three divine arms of Transylvania and a legendary bow handed down for generations among vampires. Legend has it that the souls of ever-bloodthirsty vampires are sealed in this weapon.
According to the legend, back in the beginning when the night conquered the world, the Goddess created this to light up the world. Its light is very faint now because it has almost run out.
The shield used by the king who established the Western Union. It is said to be made from an iron cauldron he had stolen from a vicious black dragon.
The hat of “Captain Jack,” a legendary hero and pirate captain of El Dorado. If a treasure is nearby, the small skull hung on the hat informs the wearer through a riddle.
One of the 4 keys used for opening the largest vault in the world located in Vegas. Despite its original purpose, people often use it in combat because of the power it contains.
This skull of a big-horned ram named “Amun” is an heirloom of Barbaria’s royal family. It is said that nothing can break it, no matter how powerful the blow is.
The axe used for beheading “Isaac,” the betrayer of Ethos. The story says that when Isaac, who intended to sell his country to the Demon King, was beheaded, his entire body burned with flame.
The whistle made of a small skull on this crossbow bellows a terrible scream every time an arrow is fired. No one knows whose skull it was.

A staff made in “Underdome,” the underground kingdom of Dark Elves. Long ago, when the Dark Elves were building the royal palace, they found a mysterious black gem deep underground. That gem was used to make this staff.
A rifle made by “Constantine,” a great pope and engineer, by combining the holy magic of Cavithan and the pinnacle of mechanical engineering. He made two rifles, but only one remains now.

A staff made using a snow crystal called the perpetual snow. It is said that the crystal is formed once every 10 millennia at the top of the Shyberian Mountains and does not melt even if it is thrown into a furnace.
A silver ladle given to only the best cook in Talia. This ladle enchanted with a unique spell is said to remove all the harmful substances in food when used for cooking.
The armor of “Agnes,” a Francisco-born and the first knightess to defeat the Demon King. It is said that this shining heavy armor contains the power of all its past wearers.
Gauntlets said to have been made from the leather of Xuanwu, an ancient divine creature. Legend has it that Xuanwu’s leather contains a mystical power that gives a blessing to its wearer.
A master sword maker of Nippon spend a long time crafting this sword to submit it to a contest. Incredibly, it outshone all the blacksmiths from the “Gigantic Anvil” and won the contest.
It is said that long ago, when the Goddess and archangels were up in the heaven, they used this staff to summon a wind that invigorated the flora and fauna.
A staff specially crafted for summoning mana oil or hired monsters. Because the finest blue crystals are used to make it, its price is unimaginably high.
Back when the Draconians ruled the world, they obtained a gem by killing “Kraken,” the ruler of the sea then, and used it to craft this axe. The gem is said to contain the power of Kraken.

The shield symbolizing Antaria, an impregnable nation surrounded with rough mountains and fortresses. Antaria is the only nation that has never been occupied by the Demon King’s army, and the legend has it that the Goddess made this shield in praise of that fact.
An ornate, butterfly-shaped metal hairpin. Long ago, a Draconian blacksmith who loved Urobo crafted this after her nickname and gifted it to her. It consists of a couple of butterflies.

A one-handed crossbow made in Sicaria for the Demon King’s secret request to assassinate the pope. Following the failure of his assassination, the pope took this crossbow from the assassin's corpse and gave it to his stepdaughter Teresa.
A bow made of a mystical tree that only grows in the secret forest known only to the Werefoxes. The cut tree is still alive, so sometimes a flower blooms from it.

A staff the Goddess bestowed to the first pope of Cavithan. It had only been used for ceremonial purposes in Cavithan’s national events, but Angela took it from the vault after the pope's disappearance.

A bell given to the shrine maidens of the East who worship the flame spirits. It is said to contain the power of flame. There is a story saying that evil beings feel excruciating pain if they hear this bell ring.
A mysterious thing that always flies around Behemo. Its big eye is always watching Behemo. Rumor says that it’s from another world, but no one knows what it really is.

This pistol is the combination of Francisco's funding, the magical kingdom Aqua’s knowledge, and the technology of the “Gigantic Anvil.” Despite its small size, its firepower is equivalent to that of a big rifle.

A long time ago, there lived a woman who was a weaver, and there was a man whom she loved. They loved each other, but the man had to leave her to fight in a war. The woman longed to see him return, waiting for him, and began to weave a beautiful fabric for him. She was going to make garments from it for him and herself. On the day that fabric was completed, the man came home in a casket. The woman then made a garment for herself and died shortly after him. The remaining fabric was said to have fallen into various hands. They say, however, that those later owners all met their untimely demises without making proper garments out of that fabric.<%enter%><%enter%>"So, it's a cursed fabric…?"<%enter%><%enter%>It was nothing but a spooky old story, but it fascinated Taila. So, she quietly sneaked out from the banquet and headed to the deserted shop.<%enter%><%enter%>—<%enter%>Under the clouded and moonless night, Taila walked on the pitch-black road with a small lantern, and managed to reach the abandoned shop after asking several locals.<%enter%>There was nothing around the deserted shop. No light, just the quiet chirpings of insects and cold breeze brushing past her. The very air around her felt eerie, but Taila was determined to find the fabric. So, she bravely entered the abandoned shop.<%enter%>It was a small, rundown two-story building that was about to collapse. It seemed to have been long abandoned, judging by the broken windows and holes on the walls.<%enter%><%enter%>As she cautiously approached the door, it suddenly opened by itself. Taila was startled but told herself it was just the wind. Once she was inside, she found nothing remarkable as looked around by the dim light of the small lantern in her hand. The eerie silence made her uncomfortable, though.<%enter%><%enter%>"I don't see anything I could use here…"<%enter%><%enter%>The first floor seemed empty. There were shattered glass bottles, discarded tables and chairs, and rubbish on the floor. Taila decided to go upstairs.<%enter%><%enter%>Then, suddenly, Taila heard the window rattle violently. Startled, Taila lost her grip on the lantern.<%enter%><%enter%>"Goodness, that scared me..."<%enter%><%enter%>Thankfully, the light didn't go out, but it made her jumpy.<%enter%><%enter%>"You'd better be careful."<%enter%><%enter%>Suddenly, she remembered the girl's words from the other day. She had never seen her or thought of those words after that day, but now that she recalled them, it began to bother her.<%enter%><%enter%>"No, it's too late to go back now."<%enter%><%enter%>Taila let out a deep breath and climbed the stairs to the second floor.<%enter%><%enter%>—-<%enter%><%enter%>The second floor was cleaner than she expected. Furnitures were well-kept and the floor was dustless. It didn't look like this place was abandoned. As Taila began to feel at ease, a door creaked open. When she turned her head, she could see what was behind it.<%enter%><%enter%>Rays of gentle moonlight flooded the room through the large window. And under that window, there was a wooden chest. It looked old but otherwise fine, and it gave off emitted a strangely mysterious feeling.<%enter%><%enter%>"I found it."<%enter%><%enter%>Certain that what she was seeking was inside that chest, Taila entered the room. And as soon as she was about to open that chest, someone tapped her shoulder.<%enter%><%enter%><%enter%>"Arghhhhhh!"<%enter%><%enter%>Startled by the touch, Taila screamed at the top of her lungs. She turned on her heels and found the girl that she met earlier, looking at her.<%enter%><%enter%>"You... You're...?"<%enter%><%enter%>"Didn't I tell you to be careful?"<%enter%><%enter%>The girl glared at Taila as if she was saying, "I told you so." Then, she quietly took a talisman out of her sleeve and put it on the chest that Taila was about to open. As soon as that talisman was placed on the chest, it began to rattle on its own.<%enter%><%enter%>Startled by the strangeness of the situation, Taila was scared. The girl asked Taila to step back, then began to recite a strange spell. Then, the talisman caught fire, making the chest stop.<%enter%><%enter%>Taila was too mesmerized to say anything. She just looked at the chest, then at the girl, then back again.<%enter%>The girl let out a deep sigh and spoke to Taila.<%enter%><%enter%>"Are you alright? I could tell that this might happen from what I saw from your face, so I gave you a fair warning. But, alas, here we are."<%enter%><%enter%>"...What was all that? And who are you?"<%enter%><%enter%>The girl answered Taila who asked with a shaking voice.<%enter%><%enter%>"I'm Ara, a sorcerer. Where you come from, I think you might say I'm... a mage, I guess? Something like that."<%enter%><%enter%>"This place has somewhat strong spiritual energy, especially during the night. So I come here from time to time to check it out. I didn't expect you to see here, though... Well, I sorta did, actually."<%enter%><%enter%>"......"<%enter%><%enter%>Taila could not understand a word that she said.<%enter%><%enter%>"Umm... This is a dangerous place. That chest has a dangerous spirit sealed in it, so you shouldn't open it. I calmed it down, so it's safe for now."<%enter%><%enter%>"......"<%enter%><%enter%>"The grannies around you are worried about you."<%enter%><%enter%>"Grannies...?"<%enter%><%enter%>"They are in colorful dresses…"<%enter%><%enter%>Again, Taila could not understand a word what Ara was talking about, but as she began to calm down, she remembered why she was there.<%enter%><%enter%>"So the fabric is not here…"<%enter%><%enter%>"Fabric?"<%enter%><%enter%>Taila told Ara of the rumor that she heard, and that made Ara giggle.<%enter%><%enter%>"I'm not sure where you heard that. Yes, this used to be a clothes shop, but it's rundown like this because the owner ran away because of debts he couldn't pay. And since it has such strong spiritual energy, I come here from time to time to look after it. That's all."<%enter%><%enter%>"Then, the rumor is…"<%enter%><%enter%>"Oh. It's not true at all."<%enter%><%enter%>"Is that so...?"<%enter%><%enter%>Taila was more disappointed by the fact that she could not find the fabric than what she experienced there.<%enter%><%enter%>"It's late, so we should go back. People will be worried."<%enter%><%enter%>"Okay…"<%enter%><%enter%>Her shoulders sunken with disappointment, Taila left the deserted house. Her steps felt heavy, but the clouds parted and the bright moon shined on her way back. And so, the perilous night passed.<%enter%><%enter%>—-<%enter%><%enter%>The scheduled events for the emissaries of Kingdom of Francisco were all wrapped up, and their last day in Corea dawned. Taila was still confused about what happened the night before, but she was still very much disappointed that she couldn't get the fabric. It must have been just a story, but she had high hopes.<%enter%>"Taila?"<%enter%><%enter%>She turned around to the voice calling her name, and found Ara, the sorceress girl, standing there. She handed a small chest to her. Ara stood there smiling, and as Taila opened the chest, she found a splendid fabric inside it. Surprised, she looked at Ara who said:<%enter%><%enter%>"The rumor about the ruin is hoax. But about that fabric? It has some truth in it. The lady in the rumor is, well, my grandmother."<%enter%><%enter%>"Huh…?"<%enter%><%enter%>"It's true that she weaved fabric, but the rumor itself is not true. Her man came home after meeting another woman, so she just threw away that fabric in the warehouse in a fit of temper. Then, it somehow became known as a cursed fabric."<%enter%><%enter%>"Then, this is…"<%enter%><%enter%>"No one would want it now, so I hope you, Taila, can make some great garments with it. There is no curse. Well, it does have just a wee bit of my granny's resentment, though…"<%enter%><%enter%>Ara seemed to be whispering the last sentence under her breath.<%enter%><%enter%>"Thank you!"<%enter%><%enter%>Taila surprised Ara by suddenly giving her a big hug, but Ara was happy to see Taila's bright face. <%enter%><%enter%>"From what I'm reading on your face, it tells me that you're a magnet for dangerous encounters. Make sure to be cautious."<%enter%><%enter%>Ara's words were mysteries to Taila, still.<%enter%><%enter%>"If we ever meet again, I will make some clothes for you!"<%enter%><%enter%>"I will look forward to it."<%enter%><%enter%>After making a promise that would take a long time to be fulfilled, Taila waved her goodbyes in the crowd of the emissaries. While watching her, Ara whispered.<%enter%><%enter%>"...Well, it should be okay with her."<%enter%><%enter%>Ara still said things that Talia could not understand, but the outcome made everyone happy. After all, achieving happiness depends on what's in our hearts.<%enter%>

An unprecedented disaster happened in Ankara.<%enter%>People plunged into chaos in a blink, and the whole city got paralyzed. Males turned into monsters and started to attack people. And with the disappearance of males who were the majority of the military force, the army couldn't defend them. I recruited princesses who I met while I was helping people as teammates, and we decided to defeat the monsters together.

Following the dramatic victory in Ankara, we headed towards "Molta," a small backwoods kingdom, in chase of the Demon King and his army. We couldn't fathom what the Demon King was trying to conspire in such a trifle kingdom that’s not even known by most ordinary people, but we set our destination to Molta off the bat to save as many people as we could.

After fighting our way through the trap laid in the royal palace of Molta, we heard the news that the Demon King had lured us to Molta and captured more than half of areas of the “Western Union” in the meantime. If the Western Union, the majority of the population of which is male, is captured by the Demon King, his army will grow tremendously.

We managed to stop the Demon King's army from capturing the Western Union entirely, but it seemed impossible to hold out anymore since their number had grown vastly. I decided to take few teammates with me and head for the Turon Empire to request reinforcements.

After defeating the Polymorph, which had imprisoned the true queen of the Turon Empire and fooled all people pretending to be the princess, we joined forces with the reinforcements from the Empire and completely driven out the army of Demon King from the Western Union.

While we were having a tough time against his army's fierce resistance, the Demon King stole the "Mirror of Illusion," a treasure of the royal family of Aqua. He used it to show his beautiful new figure across the world and dazzled numerous males of various areas, ordering them to join his army. Unable to withstand the Demon King's rapidly increasing army anymore, we decided to retreat to Talia to regroup.

After retreating to Talia, we started to search for a way to eliminate the Demon King's illusion to stop the expansion of his army. In the meantime, I met a famous magical artifactologist and learned the existence of the "Mirror of Truth," the other pair of the "Mirror of Illusion," and that by destroying it, the other mirror will also be destroyed. Chasing the trace of the "Mirror of Truth," we headed towards Francisco, the last known place to have the mirror.

We arrived at the Cathedral of Francisco after long search. However, the place was already laid waste by the Demon King's elite troops, and the mirror was long gone. Hearing from the people around the cathedral that the elite troops had headed to the border of Helvetia, we set off hurriedly towards Helvetia in pursuit.

While we were fighting fiercely against the Demon King's elite troops for the Mirror of Truth, a group of bandits stole the mirror and took flight. We managed to defeat the troops and pursued the bandits, but they were long gone without any trace. Luckily, we were able to catch a drunken bandit who had been ditched by his friends, and from her we learned that the bandits were scheming to sell off the mirror at the black market in Vegas. We headed towards Vegas in haste.

Having discovered the bandits surrounded by the Demon King's army at the black market in Vegas, we quickly mopped the troops up and captured them, but they had lost the Mirror of Truth already. The ringleader told us that they had handed the mirror over to the dealer who commissioned them to steal the mirror and left for Alchedonia. We hurriedly headed to Alchedonia, the would-be destination of the dealer.

In Alchedonia, we discovered the dealer, who was about to be killed by the elite monsters of the Demon King's army, and managed to rescue her. She revealed that she was actually the mother superior of the Central Abbey of Cavithan and persuaded us that we have to use the Mirror of Truth to disclose the Demon King’s true form hidden by those fake beautiful figure. We were suspicious of her but headed to Transylvania, the place known as where the Goddess' was abiding now, to confirm the truth.

After defeating the Demon King's underlings tenaciously trying to stop us, we managed to arrive at the royal palace of Transylvania and met the Goddess. She confirmed that the mother superior's words were true and demanded us to hand the Mirror of Truth over to her so that she can reveal the Demon King's true form. We gave it to her as she wanted, and she asked us to escort her, saying that she need to head for the Temple of Goddess hidden in Antaria Mountains to draw the power of the mirror. We gladly accepted the request and set off towards Antaria with the Goddess.

After arriving at the Temple of Goddess past a deep cave in the Antaria Mountains, we waited for the Goddess to finish her ceremony while guarding the temple's entrance. Near the end of the ceremony, there was a huge explosion in the temple and the entrance collapsed in a blink. The aftermath started to collapse the cave's several entrances one by one, and we began to run for our lives, following a path that wasn't blocked yet. It was days after we started to walk the path of endless darkness that we saw the sun again. We could see that we were now in the land of Barbaria.

While fighting the Demon King's army that invaded Barbaria without even knowing whether the Goddess was alive, we heard the news that the Demon King's illusions across the world had disappeared. Now that the Staff regained its power, we were able to control Goadhog, and Goadhog had no choice but to retreat.<%enter%>It was a hard-earned victory, and we couldn't help but feel overjoyed. However, the battle against the Demon King still lies ahead. We were incapable of regaining the western continent since it had already been occupied by the Demon King's army.<%enter%>So, we decided to ask for help from the countries of the eastern continent to gather more power to confront the Demon King. Thus, we headed to Corea, the country of the East.

The Demon King's Army, which already dominated Nippon's castle, was astonishing. However, we couldn't back down because we knew this battle would turn the tide of the war against the Demon King's Army.<%enter%>The Demon King's Army fiercely resisted against us on our way to Nippon's castle, but we were able to work together to defeat them and reclaim the castle.<%enter%>We shouted out for joy when the fight in the East ended in our victory. The East had been in an unfavorable position against the Demon King's Army, but thanks to the victory here, the East finally seized the chance to fight back against them.<%enter%>Hearing the news, other eastern countries promised to join us in the fight to oust the Demon King's Army from the Sessugarudo continent, and the story quickly spread to other countries as well. Meanwhile, some unexpected news reached us.<%enter%>To be exact, we heard a story that has been told for centuries in the East, and it goes like this. The Sage from the west had hidden something in a secret place, and when the world is in grave danger, that item will become a key to surviving the crisis. What's more, it's said that the item can be found in an old tribal city in the west.<%enter%>Saviour, the kingdom of High Elves, came to everyone's mind upon hearing this enigmatic story.<%enter%>Placing our last hopes in this story, we headed back to Saviour, the kingdom of the High Elves in the west.
While we were heading to save the people attacked by monsters, we faced monsters for the first time. This should be a good opportunity to work on our teamwork.
After carrying the day, we got a new teammate to join us. But we can't be happy for too long… We have no time to lose here. We must save as many people as we can.
Defeating the growing number of monsters, we sensed that this situation would not end overnight. But first, we have to save the people right in front of us.
Having our new teammate, we’ve got the makings of a decent party. I believe we can defeat the swarming monsters and save the people if we work together together.

We found a person attacking us alongside monsters. According to “Kate”, he is not a person but a monster called a “Polymorph.” She also said that a Polymorph is a monster with a special power of changing its shape into a powerful Hero it had seen before. This might be a tough fight.

We were able to save many people after managing to defeat Polymorph. The ones we saved told us that many monsters had swarmed towards Ankara Abbey, located at the center of the city, and asked us to save the place since a lot of children are there. We started to run towards the abbey in a hurry.
The road to the abbey was tough. A lot of monsters rushed at us as if they had been waiting to attack.
We broke through the siege but another enemy force appeared in front of us. My teammates looked very tired, but we couldn't give up there.
As we managed to break through and hastened our pace towards the abbey, a powerful-looking Polymorph emerged from afar and blocked our way.
Finally, I can now see the abbey in the distance. If we hurry, we can get there before sunset.
We caught the war cries coming from afar. As we were about to quicken our pace, we ran into monsters about to engage us in battle.

As we reached the gate, we saw that the battle nuns of the Order of the Goddess fighting fiercely against numerous monsters. The gate looked like it was about to collapse at any moment, so we had no time to waste. We decided to ambush the leader of those monsters and rushed to the battleground.
